title: Idea Engine input — topic candidates for one batch (input/ideas.json)
description: About 50 candidates written by hand or pasted from ChatGPT/Claude. Only id and topic are required. No scores: the engine scores every candidate itself. The engine (idea_engine.py validate) checks more than this schema: unique ids, non-empty topics, the exact problems per candidate.

generator.description: optional, informational: who wrote the list ("chatgpt", "claude", "me", a future generator)

id.description: unique in the file: letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'

topic.description: one question or claim the video answers, e.g. "Why do cats purr?"

angle.description: the specific answer or mechanism the video pays off (one or two sentences)

hook.description: optional hook idea; V3.0.1's hook engine writes and selects the real hook

visual.description: optional visual concept: one concrete thing to draw

category.description: free text; suggested: curiosity, science, everyday, psychology, technology, nature, human_body, space, history, engineering, strange_facts, counterintuitive, discoveries, common_questions, visual_phenomena

source_hint.description: optional URL(s) or source names; never treated as verified
